issue: The DELUSION AE has an end date (2012-11-15) earlier than its start date (2012-11-24), and it has an end date even though the outcome is NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED.
query_text: For the adverse event DELUSION, the start date is 2012-11-24 and the end date is 2012-11-15, so the event ends 9 days before it starts. The outcome is also recorded as NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED, which does not fit with an end date being entered. The HALLUCINATION event that started on the same day (2012-11-24) has no end date and the same outcome. Please check the source documents and confirm the correct start date, end date and outcome for DELUSION, then correct the CRF if needed.

issue: The Disposition form records discontinuation due to ADVERSE EVENT on 2013-03-03, but no AE record has an action taken entered, so it is not clear which event led to discontinuation.
query_text: The Disposition form records the reason for discontinuation as ADVERSE EVENT on 2013-03-03 (Week 20), and the last dose was 2013-02-27. However, the 'action taken' field is blank on all four AE records: DELUSION and HALLUCINATION (both started 2012-11-24), PRURITUS (started 2013-01-05) and PROSTATE CANCER (started 2013-02-07). Please tell us which adverse event(s) led to discontinuation of study drug, and complete the action taken field on the relevant AE record(s). If the event that led to discontinuation has not been recorded, please add it.
